data.title: What is GEO? A Complete Guide to Generative Engine Optimization
data.excerpt: Traditional SEO is evolving. Learn how to optimize your brand for AI-driven answers in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google Gemini.

children.text: Traditional SEO is evolving. As AI-powered search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google Gemini become primary information sources, brands need a new optimization strategy.

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is the practice of optimizing your brand's digital presence to be accurately represented and recommended by Large Language Models. Unlike traditional SEO which focuses on ranking in search result pages, GEO focuses on being cited and referenced in AI-generated responses.

With over 100 million weekly active users on ChatGPT alone, AI search is no longer a niche channel. Brands that fail to optimize for generative engines risk becoming invisible to a rapidly growing segment of searchers.
